message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "# This workflow uses actions that are not certified by GitHub.
# They are provided by a third-party and are governed by
# separate terms of service, privacy policy, and support
# documentation.
#
# Authors: yak3d, perchik71
# Data: 07/11/2024
# License: GPLv3

name: MSBuild

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "master" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "master" ]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  # Path to the solution file relative to the root of the project.
  SOLUTION_FILE_PATH: .
  # Configuration type to build.
  # You can convert this to a build matrix if you need coverage of multiple configuration types.
  # https://docs.github.com/actions/learn-github-actions/managing-complex-workflows#using-a-build-matrix
  BUILD_CONFIGURATION: Release
  BUILD_NOAVX2_CONFIGURATION: Release-NoAVX2
  FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build-master:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        submodules: recursive
        
      # gets the short sha to append it to the archive name
    - name: Get short SHA
      run: echo "SHORT_SHA=$("${{ github.sha }}".SubString(0, 8))" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
      
    - name: Add MSBuild to PATH
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v3

    - name: Build
      working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
      # Add additional options to the MSBuild command line here (like platform or verbosity level).
      # See https://docs.microsoft.com/visualstudio/msbuild/msbuild-command-line-reference
      run: msbuild /m /p:Configuration=${{env.BUILD_CONFIGURATION}} ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}
     
  noavx2-build-master:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    timeout-minutes: 15

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      with:
        submodules: recursive
        
      # gets the short sha to append it to the archive name
    - name: Get short SHA
      run: echo "SHORT_SHA=$("${{ github.sha }}".SubString(0, 8))" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV
      
    - name: Add MSBuild to PATH
      uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v3

    - name: Build
      working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
      # Add additional options to the MSBuild command line here (like platform or verbosity level).
      # See https://docs.microsoft.com/visualstudio/msbuild/msbuild-command-line-reference
      run: msbuild /m /p:Configuration=${{env.BUILD_NOAVX2_CONFIGURATION}} ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}",
  "rationale": "Added concurrency control to cancel superseded runs (P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE) and set a 15-minute job timeout (P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT) to prevent runaway consumption. Both changes are supported by evidence showing VM time reductions and are safe for this workflow: the concurrency group isolates by workflow and ref, preserving required checks; the timeout provides operational headroom over the observed ~7-8 minute run times. No build or test coverage is altered.",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE", "pattern:P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT", "experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]
}
